agreement.toml:
# Verifier vs the reference VLM on VideoPhy human labels (cycle A10, ADR 0011, hypothesis H2).
# Every file is pinned by revision (and sha256 for the label tables). Nothing here is tuned on
# test: the score cut is fixed on h2_dev by `agreement freeze` and frozen in preregistration.json.

[videophy]
hub_url = "https://huggingface.co"
license = "MIT (labels); videos under each generator's terms"
retries = 3
max_frames = 0                 # 0 = every frame of the clip
filter_version = 2            # 2: swing verbs back in the rigid list (the review decides)
subset_file = "videophy_subset.json"     # under paths.annotations_dir (D2, hand review)
queries_file = "videophy_queries.json"   # under paths.annotations_dir (D11)
reviewed_subsets = ["v1_test", "v2_test", "h2_test"]
# Five fixed clips of h2_dev for the local smoke run (C6): the smallest non-empty zip members.
smoke_ids = ["v1-a8208f4dd41e", "v1-0c18f4197635", "v1-af1ab1837daf", "v2-2d1753e7ddc4", "v2-bb3c51cd270a"]

[videophy.subsets]
v1_test = ["v1_test"]
v2_test = ["v2_test"]
h2_test = ["v1_test", "v2_test"]
v1_dev = ["v1_dev"]
v2_dev = ["v2_dev"]
h2_dev = ["v1_dev", "v2_dev"]

# Lexical object-object rule (D2a): keep = rigid_event and none of the exclusion lists. Words
# match whole lowercase tokens; an entry with a space matches that token sequence.
[videophy.filter]
rigid_event = [
  "fall", "falls", "falling", "fell", "drop", "drops", "dropped", "dropping",
  "bounce", "bounces", "bouncing", "bounced", "roll", "rolls", "rolling", "rolled",
  "slide", "slides", "sliding", "slid", "topple", "topples", "toppling", "toppled",
  "tumble", "tumbles", "tumbling", "tumbled", "collide", "collides", "colliding", "collided",
  "hit", "hits", "hitting", "strike", "strikes", "striking", "struck", "crash", "crashes",
  "crashing", "crashed", "knock", "knocks", "knocked", "knocking", "land", "lands", "landing",
  "tip", "tips", "tipped", "teetering", "stack", "stacked", "rest", "rests", "resting",
  "lean", "leans", "leaning", "spin", "spins", "spinning", "spun", "rotate", "rotates",
  "rotating", "smacks", "nudge", "nudges", "nudged", "pushed", "rocking",
  "swing", "swings", "swinging",
]
human_agent = [
  "man", "woman", "person", "people", "someone", "child", "children", "hand", "hands",
  "foot", "feet", "finger", "fingers", "elbow", "arm", "leg", "player", "chef", "worker",
  "librarian", "gymnast", "mechanic", "farmer", "potter", "scientist", "student", "artist",
  "detective", "chemist", "hiker", "climber", "rider", "frog", "fish", "chicken", "worm",
  "insect", "tongue", "hair", "skin", "their", "his", "her", "kicked", "thrown", "tossed",
]
nonrigid = [
  "cloth", "fabric", "paper", "papers", "rope", "string", "clay", "cheese", "dough",
  "playdough", "sponge", "towel", "tarp", "curtain", "banner", "tablecloth", "jacket",
  "shirt", "feather", "kite", "streamer", "ribbon", "balloon", "cord", "wire", "spring",
  "foam", "styrofoam", "marshmallow", "marshmallows", "pancake", "pancakes", "pizza", "rubber",
]
fracture = [
  "shatter", "shatters", "shattered", "break", "breaks", "breaking", "broken", "crack",
  "cracks", "crumpling", "crushing", "crushes", "crushed", "squashed", "tear", "rips",
  "dent", "fracture", "pieces",
]
fluid = [
  "water", "liquid", "juice", "oil", "sand", "dust", "mud", "soil", "snow", "pond",
  "puddle", "pour", "pours", "poured", "spill", "spills", "splash", "splashes", "syrup",
  "paint", "ink", "flour", "salt", "grass", "grassy",
]

# One table per (version, split). human/reference: value >= cut is "physically plausible"
# (v1 majority_pc and physics are 0/1; v2 pc is 1-5 and the paper uses pc >= 4; the AutoEval
# cuts are the published ones, never tuned). scope_* restricts rows before the lexical rule.
[videophy.parts.v1_test]
version = "v1"
split = "test"
labels = { repo = "datasets/videophysics/videophy_test_public", revision = "7841cc96c45b068eba84f42b95494530a8502b06", file = "videophy_test_public.csv", sha256 = "15bf81d7f188c0c8fb6f5a122d811ce8ff5b4acb4a9b96ce5eb15aa03ca38a7d" }
reference = { repo = "datasets/videophysics/videophy_autoeval_scores", revision = "3209a0d69702be8672e6fb76f505c5197a694439", file = "videophy_autoeval_scores.csv", sha256 = "6fc6e1b861fed4566680211931ccbef42d58ad7e591ff0590e558234183f8079" }
videos = { repo = "videophysics/videophy-test-videos", revision = "ca83be276abbffba15ffd5c6c57b6b28b91b4baa", file = "videophy_test_videos.zip", prefix = "test_videos/" }
human_column = "majority_pc"
human_cut = 1.0
reference_column = "pc"
reference_cut = 0.5
reference_name = "VideoCon-Physics"
generator_column = "source"
scope_column = "states_of_matter"
scope_value = "solid_solid"

[videophy.parts.v2_test]
version = "v2"
split = "test"
labels = { repo = "datasets/videophysics/videophy2_test", revision = "90b81ffa54f565d9e40e83b7a2c247ba1dccfa2b", file = "videophy2_test.csv", sha256 = "85a6690b9508b7e69c592f3cbcbc4113efd3a573eb5ec69d6ae030a8ffb8a4e7" }
reference = { repo = "datasets/videophysics/videophy2_autoeval_scores", revision = "5d6fd05cd3d8f0a86a1da828bb44df6f42cf699c", file = "videophy2_autoeval_scores.csv", sha256 = "ffaf935317fee5af0d5940a9b92be4f439337e8ac4596c00e573055f27b4015d" }
videos = { repo = "datasets/videophysics/videophy2_test_videos", revision = "1b920c23525d460ec47c42a135cd2eeb805a64be", file = "videophy2_test .zip", prefix = "" }
human_column = "pc"
human_cut = 4.0
reference_column = "pc_pred"
reference_cut = 4.0
reference_name = "VideoPhy-2-AutoEval"
generator_column = "model_name"
scope_column = "category"
scope_value = "Object Interactions"
rules_column = "human_violated_rules"

[videophy.parts.v1_dev]
version = "v1"
split = "dev"
labels = { repo = "datasets/videophysics/videophy_train_public", revision = "ee4750a7ee7d93bf7e2ceeb7f2a51fc7c93be4a2", file = "train.csv", sha256 = "fbad0a3fb5e95f242d4292a419effe42916f928bc8a36bb6e8cc865da34c94d4" }
videos = { repo = "videophysics/videophy-train-videos", revision = "5d328c43e9e237e03b2cd487d551c3af7c9ad8b3", file = "train_videos.zip", prefix = "train_videos/" }
human_column = "physics"
human_cut = 1.0
generator_column = "source"
scope_column = "states_of_matter"
scope_value = "solid_solid"

[videophy.parts.v2_dev]
version = "v2"
split = "dev"
labels = { repo = "datasets/videophysics/videophy2_train", revision = "5c2a69593b39d28a77ef2b9dbf7acbd2b9f38f6c", file = "videophy2_training.csv", sha256 = "076a03584da28a0622aa9f3bdad71f52c3d8afef2025d34f7ecd9e4ef081a42c" }
videos = { repo = "datasets/videophysics/videophy2_train", revision = "5c2a69593b39d28a77ef2b9dbf7acbd2b9f38f6c", file = "videophy2_train.zip", prefix = "videophy2_train/" }
human_column = "pc"
human_cut = 4.0
generator_column = ""          # deduced from the directory of video_url
scope_column = "category"
scope_value = "Object Interactions"
rules_column = "human_violated_rules"

[agreement]
rule = "calibrated"                    # A8 v2 published (ADR 0011 §6); provisional only as fallback
primary_policy = "as_plausible"
alpha = 0.05
power = 0.8
bootstrap_n = 10000
bootstrap_seed = 20261017
ci = 0.95
permutation_exact_max = 20             # caption McNemar (secondary): exact up to 20 discordant captions, else Monte Carlo
error_sample_per_class = 15
error_seed = 20261017
# Excluded and time-dependent check ids live in [check_scope] (configs/check_scope.toml).
on_unusable_stratum = "descriptive"    # calibrated rule, stratum not usable: provisional + "not evaluable"; "error" = exit 2
exclude_time_dependent = false         # ADR 0011: R5b/R4_jump stay in the primary (sensitivity without them)
dev_subset = "h2_dev"
test_subset = "h2_test"
preregistration = "agreement/preregistration.json"   # under paths.data_dir

[agreement.profiles.fast]
bootstrap_n = 1000
diagnosis.toml:
# Extractor diagnosis (cycle A6, ADR 0007). Local values are the Entregable 1 proof of the
# pipeline on this laptop (about 25 synthetic + 5 Physics-IQ + 5 PISA clips). Full datasets and
# the large runs belong to the H200: `physverify --profile precise --device cuda ... --subset full`.
# Every threshold-dependent number (verdict flips, fail rates) is provisional until A8.
[diagnosis]
dataset = "kubric_synthetic"
subset = "local"
profile_split = "calib"
report_split = "eval"
min_samples = 30

[diagnosis.metrics]
boundary_tol_frac = 0.008
depth_alignment = "clip"
depth_eps_frac = 1e-3
contact_min_tiou = 0.3
impact_half_window_s = 0.125

[diagnosis.end_to_end]
min_span_iou = 0.1
z_levels = [1.0, 2.0]

[diagnosis.factorial]
fixed_ground_truth = ["detect", "camera"]
bootstrap = 1000
seed = 0
ci = 0.95

[diagnosis.scale]
providers = ["size_prior", "free_fall"]

[diagnosis.real]
datasets = ["physics_iq", "pisa_real"]
sealed_controls = ["physics_iq_views", "objectron_static"]
motion_threshold = 127
motion_min_frac = 1e-4
moving_iou = 0.95
fall_speed_drop = 0.5
min_fall_frames = 6

[diagnosis.profiles.precise]
subset = "full"

[physics_iq]
bucket_url = "https://storage.googleapis.com/physics-iq-benchmark"
listing_url = "https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/physics-iq-benchmark/o"
license = "CC-BY-4.0"
fps_file = 16
view = "center"
takes = [1]
max_clips = 5
max_frames = 48
local = [
    "ball-and-block-fall",
    "balls-collide",
    "ball-rolls-off",
    "unstable-block-stack",
    "stable-blocks",
]
full_dynamic = [
    "ball-and-block-fall",
    "ball-hits-duck",
    "ball-hits-nothing",
    "ball-in-basket",
    "ball-ramp",
    "ball-rolls-off",
    "ball-rolls-on-glass",
    "ball-train",
    "balls-collide",
    "block-domino",
    "dominos-with-space",
    "double-cradle",
    "duck-and-dominos",
    "duck-falls-in-box",
    "marble-run-x",
    "marble-run-y",
    "mirror-ball-fall",
    "roll-behind-box",
    "roll-front-box",
    "roll-in-box",
    "single-cradle",
    "solid-ball-peakaboo",
    "two-balls-pass",
    "unstable-block-stack",
]
full_static = ["duck-static", "stable-blocks", "glass-stays-same"]
retries = 3

[physics_iq.profiles.precise]
fps_file = 30
takes = [1, 2]
max_clips = 0
max_frames = 0

# Sealed real control of the freeze: the other views of the [physics_iq] scenarios and takes.
[physics_iq_views]
views = ["left", "right"]

# Sealed real control of the freeze: Objectron test videos of still objects (Amendment 7).
# Classes, bucket and license come from [sizing]; the freeze passes the amendment seed through
# PHYSVERIFY__OBJECTRON_STATIC__SEED when it fetches (scripts/h200/run_final.sh fetch).
[objectron_static]
per_class = 6
seed = 0
seconds = 4.0
max_video_mb = 40.0
max_side = 1920            # the native long side: frames are kept at full resolution
retries = 3
# The sealed population; a dry run passes PHYSVERIFY__OBJECTRON_STATIC__SPLIT=train.
split = "test"

[pisa_real]
repo_url = "https://huggingface.co/datasets/nyu-visionx/pisa-experiments"
revision = "8f66e855fca40b7d9ab7ef947c51b52668adc762"
archive = "pisabench/real.zip"
license = "Apache-2.0"
real_fps = 120.0        # estimated capture rate; `diagnose real` reports a time-base check
max_clips = 5
max_frames = 96         # 0.8 s; target_fps 60 -> step 2 -> 48 samples
seed = 0
local_ids = ["0313", "0265", "0166", "0018", "0054"]  # seed-0 selection, pinned 2026-09-24
fall_verbs = ["falls", "drops", "is dropped", "tumbles", "slides", "rolls", "topples"]
retries = 3

[pisa_real.profiles.precise]
max_clips = 0
max_frames = 0
